DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの列車をご利用ですか。発車前に行き先を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you taking this train? Please check its destination before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 境港へ行くつもりですが、表示に別の駅名が出ています。この列車で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 境港へ行きたいのに表示が違うため列車の適否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm planning to go to Sakaiminato, but the display shows a different station name. Is this the right train?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the train is suitable because you want Sakaiminato but the display differs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この列車は境港方面ではありません。境港行きの時刻を調べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This train isn't heading toward Sakaiminato. Let's check the time for a Sakaiminato-bound train.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 危うく乗るところでした。今持っている切符は買い直す必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車間違いに気づき手元の切符の買い直し要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I almost got on it. Do I need to buy a new ticket to replace the one I have?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Realize you nearly boarded the wrong train and ask whether your ticket needs replacing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符を拝見して、区間を確認しますね。境港までの切符なので、行き先を変えなければそのまま使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll look at your ticket and check the route. It's a ticket to Sakaiminato, so you can use it as it is if your destination doesn't change.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 切符はそのままでよいのですね。境港行きがどのホームから出るか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切符を使えることを確認して境港行きのホームを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the ticket is fine as it is. Please tell me which platform the Sakaiminato train leaves from.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the ticket remains usable and ask for the Sakaiminato platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の列車のホームは、こちらの案内に出ています。途中で変更される場合は放送もお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The next train's platform is shown in this information. Please also listen for announcements in case it changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ホームの番号だけでなく、車両の境港行きという表示も見てから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ホーム番号と車両の行き先を両方確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check both the platform number and the Sakaiminato destination sign on the train before getting on.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check both the platform number and the train's destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら間違いに気づきやすいですね。まだ出発まで余裕があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will make mistakes easier to notice. There's still time before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 教えていただいたホームへ移動します。友人には到着が遅れると連絡しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しいホームへの移動と友人への遅延連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move to the platform you showed me. I'll let my friend know I'll arrive late.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to move to the correct platform and notify your friend of the delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、慌てずにお進みください。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please proceed without rushing. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雨具をお探しですか。試着用はこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for rainwear? The try-on items are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車で通勤しています。雨の日に使える上着を試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車通勤用の雨具を試したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I commute by bicycle. I'd like to try a jacket for rainy days.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to try rainwear for commuting by bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、腕を前に伸ばしてみてください。袖は手にかかりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then please stretch your arms forward. Do the sleeves cover your hands?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手の半分まで隠れます。もう一つ小さいサイズだと袖は短くなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袖が手を隠すことを説明して小さいサイズと比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They cover half my hands. Would the next size down have shorter sleeves?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the sleeves cover your hands and ask to compare a smaller size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 少し短くなりますが、肩が窮屈にならないかも比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: They'll be a little shorter, but please compare whether the shoulders feel too tight too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい方は腕を前に出すと背中が突っ張ります。元のサイズの袖を調節できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小さいサイズの背中の張りを報告して元の袖の調節方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The smaller one pulls across my back when I put my arms forward. Can I adjust the sleeves on the original size?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report tightness across the smaller size's back and ask how to adjust the original sleeves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袖口の留め具で絞れます。こちらの試着用で留めてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can tighten them with the cuff fasteners. Let's try fastening this try-on jacket.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 留めると手が出ました。普段の作業着の上からも着て確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袖口の調節効果を報告して作業着の上からの試着を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Fastening them exposed my hands. I'd also like to try it over my usual work clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the cuff adjustment's effect and ask to try it over work clothes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、その状態で肩や肘を曲げてみてください。商品はまだ試着用をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please bend your shoulders and elbows like that. Keep using the try-on item for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作業着の上でも動けます。袖口を調節できる大きい方を購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 作業着でも動けることを確認して調節可能な大きい方を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can move even over my work clothes. I'll buy the larger one with adjustable cuffs.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you can move in work clothes and choose the adjustable larger size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、新しい商品をお出しします。雨の日の通勤、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll bring out a new item. Please take care commuting on rainy days.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 準備の確認は進んでいますか。まだ機械は動かさないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: How is the preparation check going? Please don't start the machine yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部品を置きましたが、右側が少し浮いています。この状態で始めてよいか判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 加工品の右側が浮いており開始可否を判断できないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've placed the part, but its right side is raised slightly. I can't judge whether it's okay to start like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the workpiece's right side is raised and you cannot decide whether to start. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのままにして、操作を止めておきましょう。手で押さえながら動かすのは危険です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's leave it as it is and keep operation stopped. Running it while holding it down by hand is dangerous.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開始ボタンには触れません。浮いている所を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開始ボタンに触れず浮いている箇所の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't touch the start button. Could you look at the raised area?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid touching the start button and ask for the raised area to be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、責任者を呼んで確認してもらいます。固定の方法を教わった記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, I'll call the supervisor to check. Do you have a record of the fastening method you were taught?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の説明メモはありますが、この形の部品は扱っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明メモはあるが今回の形の部品は未経験だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have notes from yesterday's explanation, but I haven't handled this shape of part before.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have explanation notes but no experience with this part shape. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その違いも責任者に伝えてください。確認が終わるまでは部品を外したり直したりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the supervisor that difference too. Don't remove or adjust the part until the check is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部品を触らずに待ちます。責任者には右側が浮いていることと、初めて扱う形だと報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 部品を触らず待ち傾きと未経験の形を責任者に報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait without touching the part. I'll tell the supervisor its right side is raised and this is my first time with this shape.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait without touching the part and report the tilt and unfamiliar shape to the supervisor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私からも連絡します。再開の指示を受けたら、固定の確認を一緒に行いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll contact them too. Once you receive instructions to resume, let's check the fastening together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 指示だけで急いで再開せず、固定できたことを確かめてから操作します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再開指示後も固定状態を確認してから操作すると約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't rush to restart just because I've received instructions. I'll operate it after confirming it's fastened.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to check the fastening before operating even after restart instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その進め方でお願いします。いったん作業を離れて、また後ほどお会いしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed that way. Step away from the work for now, and I'll see you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ロープウェイの乗車口はこちらです。大きなお荷物がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The ropeway boarding entrance is here. You have a large bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このかばんを持って乗れるか心配です。先に大きさを見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行かばんを持ち込めるか乗車前の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm worried whether I can board with this bag. Could you check its size first?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a check before boarding of whether your travel bag may be brought on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで確認しますので、列の外の広い場所へお寄せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check here, so please bring it to the open space outside the line.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 列をふさがないように移動しました。かばんを預ける場所もあるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列をふさがない所へ移動して荷物預かりの有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've moved so I don't block the line. Is there also somewhere I can leave the bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move without blocking the line and ask whether luggage storage is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この乗り場には預かりの窓口があります。空きと受け取りの時刻は、そちらの係員に尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This boarding point has a luggage-storage desk. Please ask the attendant there about availability and collection times.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 往復する予定なので、戻った時に受け取れるか聞いてから預けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 往復後に受け取れる時刻を尋ねてから預けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm planning a return trip, so I'll ask whether I can collect it when I get back before leaving it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about collection after the return trip before storing the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その順番でお願いします。中に、乗っている間に使う物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please follow that order. Is there anything inside you'll use during the ride?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲み物と財布が入っています。その二つは取り出して手元に持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲み物と財布をかばんから取り出して持つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: There's a drink and my wallet. I'll take those two out and keep them with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will remove the drink and wallet from the bag and carry them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取り出したら、預かり窓口で手続きをしてください。切符の購入は、その後でも間に合います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've taken them out, complete the storage procedure at the desk. You'll still have time to buy a ticket afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かばんを預けられたら切符を買い、受け取り時刻に間に合う便を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預けられた後に切符を買い受取時刻に合う便を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I'm able to store the bag, I'll buy a ticket and choose a service that gets me back before the collection time.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will buy a ticket after successful storage and choose a service matching the collection time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、戻りの時間も係員とお確かめください。どうぞ楽しんでいらしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please confirm the return time with the attendant too. Enjoy your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 収穫する列は確認できましたか。はさみを使う前に札を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you checked which row to harvest? Look at the sign before using scissors.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明では三番の列と聞きましたが、目の前の札は五番です。場所を間違えたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指示された三番と目の前の五番の違いを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The explanation said row three, but the sign in front of me says five. It looks like I'm in the wrong place.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the difference between instructed row three and the row-five sign in front of you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここは五番で、今日は収穫しない列です。まだ切っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is row five, which isn't being harvested today. You haven't cut anything yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一本も切っていません。かごもここに置かず、三番まで運び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ切っていないことを伝えてかごを正しい列へ移すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't cut even one. I won't leave the basket here either; I'll carry it to row three.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have cut nothing and will move the basket to the correct row. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: よかったです。三番は奥の通路の左側ですが、入口で番号をもう一度確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's good. Row three is on the left of the passage at the back, but let's check the number again at its entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三番の札が見えました。この列でも、小さい実は残すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三番の札を確認して小さい実を残すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can see the row-three sign. Should I leave the small fruit in this row too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the row-three sign and ask whether small fruit should be left. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、収穫する大きさの見本を見てください。迷う物は切らずに、私を呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, look at the sample of the size to harvest. If you're unsure about one, call me without cutting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見本より小さい実と、判断できない実はそのままにして相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小さい実と判断できない実を切らず相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll leave fruit smaller than the sample and anything I can't judge as they are and ask you.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask without cutting small fruit or fruit you cannot assess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでお願いします。かごは通路をふさがない位置に置いてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Put the basket somewhere that doesn't block the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かごを列の脇に置きました。三番の札と見本を確かめてから収穫を始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: かごを通路脇に置き札と見本を確認して収穫を始めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've put the basket beside the row. I'll start harvesting after checking the row-three sign and sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put the basket beside the passage and say you will check the sign and sample before harvesting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、最初の数本は一緒に見ます。では、よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we'll look at the first few together. Let's get started.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の前に、うどんと取られたおかずを確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before payment, I'll check your udon and the side dishes you took.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 肉うどんを頼みましたが、器には肉が入っていません。受け取った時からこの状態です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 肉うどんの器に受取時から肉がないことを申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I ordered meat udon, but there's no meat in the bowl. It's been like this since I received it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the meat udon bowl has had no meat since you received it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文を受けた担当に聞きます。器はそのまま台に置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask the person who took your order. Could you leave the bowl on the counter as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 台に置きました。肉を追加してもらえるなら、注文は肉うどんのままでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 器を台に置き肉を追加できれば注文を維持したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've put it on the counter. If you can add the meat, I'd like to keep my order as meat udon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Place the bowl on the counter and say you want to keep the order if meat can be added. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が盛り付けを忘れたそうです。今、肉を入れてお戻しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member says they forgot to add it. We'll put the meat in now and return it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。横の天ぷらは友人の分なので、うどんとは別の会計にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の天ぷらをうどんと別会計にしたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. The tempura beside it is my friend's, so I'd like its bill separate from the udon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for your friend's tempura to be billed separately from the udon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、天ぷらのお皿をこちらに分けてください。ご友人は一緒にレジへ来られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please separate the tempura plate over here. Can your friend come to the register with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人を呼びます。私は肉うどんだけを先に払ってもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人を呼び自分の肉うどんを先に払えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll call my friend. May I pay just for my meat udon first?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Call your friend and ask whether you can pay for your own meat udon first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらの肉うどんの会計を先に行います。戻ってきた器の中身もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll handle this meat udon payment first. Please check the contents of the returned bowl too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 肉が入っているのを確認しました。私はこの一杯だけを支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 肉が入ったことと自分が払う一杯を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked that the meat is there. I'll pay for just this one bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the meat is present and the single bowl you will pay for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待たせしました。どうぞお席で、温かいうちに召し上がってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for waiting. Please take a seat and enjoy it while it's hot.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 窓口のご用件をお伺いします。お手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask what you need at the counter? Is it a banking procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝からキャッシュカードが見当たりません。探すより先に利用を止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今朝からカードがないと伝えて捜索より先の停止を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't been able to find my cash card since this morning. I'd like to stop its use before looking for it further.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the card has been missing since this morning and you want it blocked before searching. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紛失の受付を進めます。本人確認の書類をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll proceed with the lost-card report. Do you have identification documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードがあります。通帳は家ですが、口座を確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 在留カードはあるが通帳が家にある状況で口座確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my residence card. My passbook is at home, but could you check my account?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request an account check with your residence card while your passbook is at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちの書類と登録情報で確認します。暗証番号はおっしゃらないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check using the documents you have and your registered information. Please don't tell us your PIN.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 暗証番号は伝えません。本人確認ができたら、停止を受け付けたことをどう確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 暗証番号を伝えず停止受付結果の確認方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't give my PIN. Once my identity is verified, how can I confirm that the blocking request has been accepted?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not disclose your PIN and ask how to confirm acceptance of the blocking request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手続きが終わりましたら、受付の控えをお渡しして内容をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: After the procedure is complete, we'll give you an acknowledgment copy and explain its contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 控えを受け取ります。帰宅してカードが見つかった場合も、そのまま使わない方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えの受取を希望し発見後のカードをそのまま使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take the copy. If I find the card after getting home, should I avoid using it as it is too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to receive the copy and whether a recovered card can be used unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、停止後に見つかったカードは、再び使う前に銀行へ連絡してください。本人確認と停止の受付が終わりましたので、こちらが控えです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, if you find the card after it's blocked, contact the bank before using it again. Identity verification and acceptance of the block are complete, so here's your copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停止の控えを確認しました。見つかっても勝手に使わず連絡し、再発行は必要事項を聞いてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止の控えを確認し発見時は連絡して再発行は説明後に決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the blocking acknowledgment. If I find it, I'll contact you instead of using it myself, and decide about reissuance after asking what is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the blocking copy, say you will contact the bank if found and decide on reissuance after an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 再発行については、この案内をお持ち帰りください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TTR-YONAGO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this reissuance guide home. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お乗換えについてですか。

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。待ち時間に外で写真を撮り、戻って乗るつもりです。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待ち時間の施設外撮影を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I plan to take photos outside during the wait, then return and board.
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss taking photos outside the facility while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗継ぎの時刻と戻る経路は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked the connecting departure time and route back?

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 時刻だけです。外へ出ても同じ待ち列へ戻れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列復帰を未確認だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the time. I thought I could return to the same waiting line even if I went outside.
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you had not checked whether you could rejoin the line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一度列を離れた場合の扱いも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-05.translation: You also need to check what happens if you leave the line.

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、先に外へ出ず、係員へその条件を聞きます。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 離列前の扱い確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't go outside first; I'll ask the attendant about those conditions.
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check how leaving the line is handled before doing so. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同行者は同じ行程ですか。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does your companion have the same itinerary?

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人は列で待つ予定でした。私だけ戻れないと困るので、一緒に相談します。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者との乗継ぎ不一致を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend was planning to wait in the line. It would be a problem if only I couldn't get back, so we'll ask together.
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid a mismatch with your companion's connection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 急いで外へ出る必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you need to hurry outside?

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありません。乗継ぎを優先し、条件が合わなければ撮影は後にします。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影より乗継ぎを優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. I'll prioritize the connection and take photos later if the conditions don't work.
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prioritize the connection over photography. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 乗継ぎ担当にご案内します。列を離れる前に、お二人でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-TYM-KUROBE-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take you to the connecting-service staff. Please both check before leaving the line.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 名義のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the account name?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。来月から父が払います。使うのは私ですが、使用者名も父に変えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 使用者と払込者の名義関係を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My father will pay from next month. I'm the user, but should the user name change to my father's too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the relationship between the user name and payer name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支払方法と使用者の情報は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the payment method separately from the user's information.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住む人は変わりません。支払いだけ父に頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 居住者不変と支払者だけ変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The person living there won't change. I'm only asking my father to handle payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the resident remains the same and only the payer changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの方法で支払う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: What payment method are you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父の口座を考えています。本人の同意を得てから申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族口座の同意後申込みを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm thinking of my father's bank account. I'd like to apply after getting his consent.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to apply using a family member's account after their consent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手続きに必要な情報をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain the information needed for the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。私の名前を先に消さず、支払方法だけ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使用者名を消さず支払方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I won't remove my name first; I'll discuss only the payment method.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss the payment method without deleting the user's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の請求書はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have the current bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: これです。お客様番号を使って、変更対象を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 請求書で対象を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here it is. Please use the customer number to confirm which account is to be changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify the account using the bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 請求情報から確認します。使用者の変更と支払方法の変更を区別してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check from the billing information. We'll explain the user change separately from the payment-method change.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は三人で登られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are three of you climbing today?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予定は三人でしたが、一人が来られず、今は二人です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 実際の登山人数減少を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: We planned for three, but one person couldn't come, so there are two of us now.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the actual decrease in the climbing party. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 届ける予定の情報も二人に直しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you also corrected the information you plan to submit to two people?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。友人に送った行程には三人と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共有済行程が未更新と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. The itinerary I sent my friend says three people.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report that the shared itinerary has not been updated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出発前に、人数の変更も知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before setting off, please notify them of the number change too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。不参加の人が途中で合流する予定もありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中合流予定がないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The absent person doesn't plan to join us along the way either.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that nobody plans to join partway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 帰りの連絡をする相手は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided whom to notify when you return?

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 参加しない友人に頼みます。二人分の行程で、帰着の連絡をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不参加者を帰着連絡先にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask the friend who isn't participating. I'll report our return based on the itinerary for two people.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make the nonparticipating friend your return contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今の状況や装備も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's also check the current conditions and your equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。人数を直すだけでなく、二人で予定どおり進めるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数変更後の行程再確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Rather than only changing the number, we'll check whether the two of us can proceed as planned.
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request an itinerary recheck after the party-size change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な確認を済ませてから判断してください。古い人数のまま出発しないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TYM-KUROBE-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please decide after completing the necessary checks. Let's make sure you don't depart with the old party size still recorded.
